modelLibraryAssignments.label: Studio — model library assignments
modelLibraryAssignments.help: Which library each full-body model profile belongs to (Men, Ladies or Kids), one choice per model. Starts empty — a model is not in any library until you assign it here.

modelStylingGuideline.label: Studio — model styling guideline
modelStylingGuideline.help: How you want each model profile dressed and posed in generated photos (e.g. "ladies profile 2 — modest, full sleeve, soft smile"), one note per model. Starts empty.

kidsModelEnabled.label: Studio — allow a kids model
kidsModelEnabled.help: Off by default. Several AI providers restrict generating realistic photos of children, and ghost-mannequin/flat-lay photos of kidswear already look clean and cost less. Turn this on only if you want a real kids model profile to appear in generated photos, and also point Kidswear's own recipe at the Kids library in the category recipe settings.
